_readme: Amazon Associates product config for trygomoku.com — ENGLISH PAGES ONLY.
1) Replace 'tag' with your real Associates ID (looks like xxxxxxxx-20). Nothing earns commission until you do.
2) 'asin' is optional. Leave it empty and the link falls back to an Amazon SEARCH url with your tag —
it still tracks and converts, so nothing is ever a dead link. Fill in an ASIN later to link a specific product.
3) NEVER put product images or hard-coded prices in these blocks. Amazon only permits images/prices via the
Creators API (needs 10 qualifying sales in 30 days) with a timestamp + disclaimer. Text-only until then.
4) Run:  python tools/gen_amz_blocks.py          (dry-run, shows what would change)
5) IMPORTANT: gen_amz_blocks.py skips blocks that already carry data-amz, so it will NOT refresh
an existing module after you edit a label/note/query here. Either edit the page by hand or strip
the block first. Articles published through content_pipeline.py always render the current config.
renju-board-vs-go-board, board-games-like-gomoku, gomoku-board-game-gifts) are published with:

gomoku-board-setup-and-basic-rules.title: What a physical board and stones actually look like
gomoku-board-setup-and-basic-rules.note: A standard set is a 15×15 grid of 225 points with two colours of stones — exactly the layout the game on the home page uses. If you want to feel how the grid behaves under your hand, a wooden board is the cheapest way to find out.

gomoku-family-game-night.title: Gomoku sets that survive family game night
gomoku-family-game-night.note: The rule of thumb from the article above: a folding wooden board for the table, a magnetic one for the car. Stones beat plastic pegs — they never rattle loose and they feel better in the hand.
